name: usage-footer
description: Prompt footer with model, effort, context bar, 5h limit and cache countdown; keeps the prompt cache warm during work hours and compacts when idle after them

keepAlive.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepAlive.description: During work hours, ping the model when the cache has ~5 min left and you are idle; after the idle-ping limit or outside work hours, compact once instead.

keepAliveFrom.title: Work hours start (HH:MM)
keepAliveFrom.description: Local time from which idle keep-alive pings are sent.

keepAliveUntil.title: Work hours end (HH:MM)
keepAliveUntil.description: Local time after which an idle session is compacted instead of kept warm. Equal to the start: no work hours at all.

keepAliveDays.title: Work days (e.g. Mon-Fri)
keepAliveDays.description: Days with work hours: ranges and lists such as Mon-Fri, Mon,Wed,Fri or Mon-Sun. Other days are treated as after hours.

maxIdlePings.title: Idle pings before compacting
maxIdlePings.description: Pings in a row without a message from you; the next near-expiry compacts instead. 0 = no limit.

minCompactTokens.title: Smallest context to compact (tokens)
minCompactTokens.description: Below this an idle session is left to expire instead of compacted: rebuilding a small context costs less than a summary.

utcOffset.title: UTC offset override (e.g. +07:00)
utcOffset.description: Leave empty to use the system timezone. From -12:00 to +14:00.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 60 for the 1-hour cache this setup uses; set lower only to test the keep-alive quickly.

logUsage.title: Log usage per turn
logUsage.description: Write a dim line after each turn with its cache read/written tokens and the 5-hour meter before and after; for measuring what the keep-alive saves.
